heading: 295% return in 5 years: Jaiprakash Power Ventures share price zooms 12% today - what's driving the rally?
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: Shares of Jaiprakash Power Ventures Limited surged nearly 12% following a payment settlement agreement with NARCL. The agreement involves a full payment of  ₹511 crores and withdrawal of IBC proceedings upon fulfillment of conditions.
